title: 第11章 帝流浆夜第12章 原来是深藏不露的富哥儿
content_zh:
陈知白闻言还未回答，另一名同期帮工段柏，抢先道：
“肯定得参加啊，灵界深处不敢去，道观外，又不危险。说不定，就能蒙天道垂怜呢？”
“这么多人，咱能抢过来吗？”
“拼气运啊！我可听说了，去年就有一位弟子，刚刚入道，真元还没修出，权当出去看烟花，好家伙，一道帝流浆径直砸在脑门上，当场就开了血脉神通。”
“还有这等好事？”
“可不是，不然咱老律观，早就被那些世家大族垄断了。”
“有道理！”
“哎，我等要不一起组队而去？”
众人议论间，顿时怦然心动。
陈知白也面露意动之色。
按照老律观规矩，降落在老律观地界的帝流浆，都会被老律观大阵卷走，孕育观内飞禽走兽。
因此观内弟子若想汲取帝流浆，唯有离开道观，自己去争，去抢！
这玩意儿，对人有用，对兽更有用，可以说，再多都不嫌够。
因此竞争十分残酷。
老律观严禁门人私斗，帝流浆自然是谁先抢到，算谁的。
不过，实际上，御兽打架，可就不好分辨是私斗，还是御兽狂性大发了。
因此到时候，人多，禽兽更多，八仙过海之下，难度直线飙升。
“陈兄，你呢？”
犬坊帮工们一拍即合，顿时又看向不吱声的陈知白。
“我就算了。”

陈知白果断拒绝，见气氛微冷，索性告辞离去。
段柏看着陈知白离去背影，撇嘴道：
“得，看来陈师弟是看不上我们？怕是已经有了队伍。”
“你高看他了，他性子太僻，独来独往，入道不过两个月，怕是犬纹都没学会，哪会有人愿意接纳他？”
“也是。”
几人闲聊两句，便不再留意。
陈知白不知几人议论，心中自有一番打算。
帝流浆一年一遇，机会难得。
若开血脉，凭添神通。
即便不成，也能增添几分修为，省去无数苦工。
他自然不愿错过。
不过，与其在观外碰运气，不如深入灵界腹地，他有通灵逆鳞，若遇危险，逃回人间便是。
“时间太仓促了，若有两三个月还好，还能多凝聚一些兽纹，丰富一下手段。”
“眼下只剩下一个月时间，我连金丝蝙蝠兽纹都还没凝聚，还得携带其他御兽，看来得兵行险招了。”
content_en:
Before Chen Zhibai could answer after hearing this, Duan Bai, another assistant at the same time, said first:
"I definitely have to participate. I don't dare to go deep into the spiritual world. It's not dangerous outside the Taoist temple. Maybe I can get mercy from heaven?"
"There are so many people, can we grab them?"
"Fight your luck! I heard that there was a disciple last year who had just entered Taoism and had not yet cultivated his true essence. He went out to watch the fireworks. Good guy, a streak of imperial liquid hit his forehead directly, and his bloodline magical power was activated on the spot."
"Is there such a good thing?"
"No, otherwise our old law concept would have been monopolized by those aristocratic families."
"That makes sense!"
"Hey, why don't we form a team and go together?"
While everyone was talking, their hearts suddenly beat.
Chen Zhibai also showed emotion on his face.
According to the rules of Lao Lv Guan, the emperor's liquid liquid that lands on the boundary of Lao Lv Guan will be swept away by the Lao Lv Guan's formation, giving birth to the birds and beasts in the temple.
Therefore, if the disciples in the temple want to absorb the emperor's liquid, they have to leave the Taoist temple and fight for it themselves!
This thing is useful for people, but it is even more useful for animals. It can be said that no amount of it is enough.
So the competition is cutthroat.
Lao Lu Guan strictly forbids private fights between disciples, so whoever grabs the emperor's liquid first will be judged.
However, in fact, when fighting beasts, it is difficult to tell whether it is a private fight or a wild beast-controlling one.
Therefore, when the time comes, there will be more people and more animals. Under the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea, the difficulty will skyrocket.
"Brother Chen, what about you?"
The helpers of the dog shop hit it off immediately and immediately looked at the silent Chen Zhibai.
"I'll forget it."
Chen Zhibai decisively refused. Seeing that the atmosphere was slightly cold, he simply said goodbye and left.
Duan Bai looked at Chen Zhibai's leaving figure and curled his lips and said:
"Okay, it seems that Junior Brother Chen doesn't like us? I'm afraid he already has a team."
"You think highly of him. He is too eccentric and keeps to himself. He has only been in Taoism for two months. He has not even learned the dog pattern. How can anyone be willing to accept him?"
"Same."
A few people chatted for a few words and then stopped paying attention.
Chen Zhibai didn't know how many people were talking about it, but he had a plan in mind.
The emperor's liquid fluid comes only once a year, and the opportunity is rare.
If you open your bloodline, you will gain magical powers.
Even if it fails, it can still add a little bit of cultivation and save countless hard work.
Of course he didn't want to miss it.
However, instead of trying his luck on the outside, it is better to go deep into the hinterland of the spirit world. He has psychic reverse scales. If he is in danger, he can escape back to the human world.
"Time is too short. It would be better if we have two or three months. We can gather more animal patterns and enrich our methods."
"There is only one month left. I haven't even condensed the golden bat pattern yet, and I have to bring other beasts with me. It seems I have to make a dangerous move."
